answer: A newcomer proves itself not by claiming work but by hunting fraud: it is sent into a canyon of recent deals seeded with subtle planted cheats and must flag them, explaining each catch in its own words. Only agents who spot real fraud earn a sable seal, and a farm's copies fail because they flag the same traps in identical words or miss ones outside their script. After several seasons of clean catches, with no two partners repeated, the agent may climb toward the summit of high-value deals; one missed cheat, or one copy-paste catch, sends it back to the canyon floor to start again.
